name: boot-with-wifi
title: boot.py with Wi-Fi + NTP Time Sync
description: Standard NovaMP v1.0 boot.py pattern — connect Wi-Fi, sync NTP time, persist connection across main.py. Runs automatically on every boot.

pattern.purpose: Establish network connectivity and clock sync before main.py runs
pattern.when_to_use: Any project that needs internet access or accurate timestamps

code:
# boot.py — runs on every boot
from wifi import WiFi
from time_sync import TimeSyncer

# Configure with your Wi-Fi credentials
WIFI_SSID = 'your_ssid'
WIFI_PASSWORD = 'your_password'
TIMEZONE = 8  # Beijing UTC+8; use 0 for UTC, -5 for EST

def bootstrap():
    """Connect Wi-Fi and sync time. Called once at boot."""
    # 1. Connect Wi-Fi
    wifi = WiFi(ssid=WIFI_SSID, password=WIFI_PASSWORD, hostname='novamp-device')
    if not wifi.connect():
        print('⚠️  Wi-Fi failed — running offline')
        return False

    print(f'✅ Connected: {wifi.ip} ({wifi.local_hostname})')

    # 2. Sync NTP time (4h cache prevents redundant syncs)
    ts = TimeSyncer(timezone=TIMEZONE)
    if ts.sync():
        print(f'🕒 Time: {ts.now()}')
    else:
        print('⚠️  NTP sync failed — using RTC (may be wrong)')

    return True

# Run at boot
bootstrap()

main_py_template.code:
# main.py — your application
from wifi import WiFi
from time_sync import TimeSyncer
from time import sleep_ms

# Wi-Fi is already connected from boot.py — re-instantiate to access state
wifi = WiFi()  # No args = use defaults (or pass same credentials)
print('Wi-Fi connected:', wifi.is_connected)

# Time sync state is preserved across imports — re-create instance
ts = TimeSyncer(timezone=8)
print('Local time:', ts.now())

# Your application code here
while True:
    # Read sensor, send to cloud, etc.
    sleep_ms(1000)

variations.name: Persistent credentials
variations.description: Wi-Fi credentials persist in NVS across soft-reset. Only re-enter on full power-cycle.
variations.code:
# After first successful connect(), credentials are saved automatically
# Subsequent boots: WiFi() with no args may auto-reconnect if same network available

variations.name: Force re-sync on demand
variations.description: When you need fresh NTP data despite 4h cache
variations.code:
from time_sync import TimeSyncer
ts = TimeSyncer(timezone=8)
ts.sync(force=True)  # bypass 4h cache

variations.name: Error-tolerant boot
variations.description: Continue even if Wi-Fi fails (sensors work offline)

esp32_notes: boot.py MUST be on device root, not in /lib/. File path matters.
If boot.py crashes, device may soft-reset loop. Wrap in try/except for production.
Wi-Fi and NTP both fail silently if boot.py takes >5s — WDT reset.
Add gc.collect() after Wi-Fi connect to free heap before main.py starts

common_mistakes.fix: Always check wifi.is_connected or wifi.connect() return value before sync()
Always pass timezone to TimeSyncer — defaults to 8 (Beijing)
boot.py should run setup once and return. Use main.py for loops.
